_comment: AlfieBot settings. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Delete a key to use its built-in default.

display._comment: The 5-inch Pi display is 1280x720 in landscape. Lower supersample or glow if the Pi runs slowly.

conversation._comment: Seconds. listen_timeout: how long AlfieBot waits for an answer before going idle. sleep_after_idle: idle time before falling asleep. thinking_time: pause before replying. wake_delay: time for the eyes to open when woken from sleep.

speech._comment: tts_engine: auto (Windows voice on Windows, espeak-ng on the Pi), windows, espeak or none. voice: part of a voice name, e.g. Hazel or George on Windows, en-gb on espeak. rate: -10 (slow) to 10 (fast). volume: 0-100. recognizer: vosk or none. mic_mode: open (listens whenever AlfieBot is listening) or push_to_talk (only while the button is held). mic_device: blank for the default microphone, or part of its name. min_confidence: spoken spelling answers below this are read back for a yes/no.

spelling._comment: How spoken spellings are checked. confirm_spoken_answers: always (AlfieBot reads the letters back for a yes before marking) or when_unsure (only when a letter was unclear). phonetic_words: child (B for ball), nato (B for bravo) or off, used when AlfieBot asks about an unclear letter. finish_after_pause: seconds of quiet after some letters before AlfieBot checks them (0 = wait for 'finished').

privacy._comment: Parent settings. The microphone stays off until a parent turns it on. Audio is never saved unless keep_audio_recordings is true.
